US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
more_info.overview: Formic acid is used as a preservative in food. Its technological role is to help limit microbial spoilage.
more_info.daily_intake: For formic acid: 0-3 mg/kg body weight (1979) (JECFA, 1997). This evaluation does not establish an ADI for every form in the named group.
